messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I wanted to confirm that I’ll have no trouble delivering this by mid-afternoon on Friday (12/8).

Hope you have a great day.
\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]! I’ll actually be OOO on both Friday and Monday. Could you share your work in a Google Doc with [EMAIL_001] and <http:[EMAIL_002]?[EMAIL_003]?> They can look it over while I’m away, and once I return to the office on Tuesday, I can send your payment and feedback.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That’s no problem, and thank you for the guidance. I’ll add those individuals to the sharing settings. Enjoy your weekend!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
A few days have passed since we last spoke, so I wanted to check that my deliverable reached you.
Thank you, and I hope you have a great day!
\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!

Thank you for checking in. I’ve just finished reviewing your article, and you did an excellent job. The writing is strong, though the blog could be improved further by adding a little more storytelling—for example, engaging introductions that break up lengthy informational lists. My team and I left feedback directly in the article for you to review and address with the appropriate edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the comments and made the revisions, we’ll be ready to send your test article to our client. We really appreciate your work on this and look forward to receiving the updated version.

Article containing Fire&Spark feedback: [URL_001]

Please reach out if you have any questions!

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
It’s good to hear from you. I’ll go through the edits you provided. By when would you like me to complete and return the updated draft?

\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: It would be ideal to receive them tomorrow morning. However, if that turnaround is too short, delivery by the end of the week will also be fine.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
ok. I’ll see what I’m able to put together.
I think I just have one broad question about the comments. I saw the general request to add more content/words, which is fine and something I can do. My original approach was to keep the writing very concise so the blog would remain under the 1000 words requirement. If going slightly over is acceptable, I can certainly add more introductions in the places you noted. I only wanted to confirm that the word count was not a strict limit.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The word count is not a hard limit, though I appreciate your careful attention to that detail!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I believe I’ve now addressed your comments in the google doc you shared. I kept the one comment you left open so that you can view how I resolved it.
[URL_002]

I enjoyed working on this project and hope we have another opportunity to collaborate soon!
\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
The blog looks excellent, and the revisions are exactly what we wanted. The next step is for us to send your test article to our client. After they have reviewed and approved your work, I’ll contact you to talk about a monthly copywriting cadence, compensation, and timeframes.

We’ll talk soon!
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
That’s fantastic news! I’m very happy to hear it.
I look forward to hearing from you again soon. If I don’t hear back until after the holiday season, I hope you and the team have a wonderful weekend and a restful holiday season.

\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I realize we’re very close to the end of the year and in the middle of the holiday season, but I wanted to check whether your client has shared any feedback on the test article I completed. I’m ready to begin whenever you are!

Wishing you a relaxing close to the year!
\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. I hope your holiday weekend was great, and thank you for following up! Our client’s site recently launched, so the past few weeks have been hectic. They still have not reviewed your work, but I’m hoping they’ll provide feedback sometime this week. I’ll get back to you as soon as I have more information.

Happy New Year,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I have great news! Century Spring has reviewed your work and would like to arrange a meeting with you. They want to hear more about your background and share some context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available for a call this week.

The team also left feedback and suggested edits on your test article, which are available here: [URL_003]

Let me know if anything is unclear or if you have questions!

In addition to arranging that meeting, my team would like to give you your next copywriting assignment. Rather than creating a blog article this time, you’ll revise the copy on an existing landing page on [URL_004]. I can provide the brief tomorrow. Regarding your rates, approximately how many hours do you anticipate a copy editing project will require?

Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I’d be delighted to meet with Century Spring, and thank you for forwarding their feedback! I don’t know which time slots are open, but I’m available any day this week before 11am EST, as well as Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday this week after 1pm EST. Unfortunately, my schedule is quite full this afternoon (Monday), so I can’t meet then.

I’ll review the landing page and send you an estimate of the hours this afternoon.

The only other thing I’m wondering is this: assuming the meeting with Century Spring goes well and they’re happy with what I can provide, how much work do you expect the overall project to involve? I’m asking because having more information about a project helps me plan and prioritize my time more effectively.

Thanks!
\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Great! I’ll share those available times with them and then send a Google Meets invitation. Which email address should I use for the invite?

This is the particular landing page you’ll revise: [URL_005]. Just as with the previous brief, we’ll include detailed directions for what we want in every section.

At present, we anticipate approximately 4 assignments each month. Because blogs are expected to require more time than copy-editing work, we may replace 1 blog with 2 copy-editing tasks when necessary.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I use a separate email address specifically for this kind of work. Please send it to: [EMAIL_004]

Thank you for clarifying the workflow!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I believe an estimate of roughly **5 hours** is reasonable for revising the copy on the page you shared. I’m comfortable using the same hourly rate I previously quoted for the first article ($45/hr), along with the same turnaround after I receive the contract and every material required to begin (4 days).

I hope these terms work for you. I’m ready to get started whenever you need me to!

\-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: That works for me—thanks for letting me know! I can send you a new milestone tomorrow :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’ve just sent you an invitation for tomorrow’s meeting at 1 pm ET!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: got it. I’ll attend at that time (in case the google confirmation hadn’t shown up for you)!
